questions.question: What is in M0? PRD-v2.md:213 says M0 = spikes S0 and S1 only (S0 done 2026-10-12). TECH-SPEC §9 lists 7 open spikes (S-NODE, S-COPILOT, S-ZCODE, S-NAMES, S-SKILLS, S-CODEX, G25). PRD-v2.md:216 M3 still lists Cursor, Kimi, JetBrains, agy, Zed, which TECH-SPEC §2 removed. Which list is M0, and which spikes must close before I write store code?
questions.why: I cannot plan M0 from the docs. The PRD milestones contradict TECH-SPEC §2 and §9.

questions.question: Which storage model do I build? PRD-v2.md:75-84 says per-connection sessions/<server-id>.db, journal JSONL, and '--fix deletes only that session DB' (#867). ADR-0002 (Accepted) says one context.db per project. grep 'orrupt' in ADR-0002 gives 0 hits. What do I do when the one shared context.db is corrupt, and who may delete it?
questions.why: Blocker from INTERN-QA-r2 is still open. With one DB, v1's 'delete only that session DB' rule would delete all project data.

questions.question: ADR-0007:47 still says agent and session come 'from request _meta and hook payloads, never from the connection'. Claude Code and Codex send clientInfo only once, in initialize (v1 reads it via getClientVersion, introduced d11d8d26/103b41dd 2026-02-24). Which single accessor do I code for 2025-xx clients so #542 does not come back?
questions.why: r2 flagged this as a blocker; ADR-0007 text is unchanged. Without it, agent detection breaks on the two reference agents.

questions.question: Does the ctx_execute / ctx_batch server path check the user's deny rules? v1 does (src/server.ts:1111-1147 checkDenyPolicy, from b3f93eba 2026-03-03 'feat(security): add permission enforcement for MCP sandbox tools', PR #34: 'MCP execute/execute_file/batch_execute deny/ask enforcement'). ADR-0008 does not name the ctx tools; PRD G6 moves policy to ~/.context-mode/policy.json. Which file is the policy source, and is the server-side check MUST?
questions.why: Git archaeology: dropping it re-opens a bypass that v1 fixed. That is a blocker by the review rule.

questions.question: ADR-0003 title and line 35, TECH-SPEC GS4 and §6.8 still say 'delete v1 tests/ in one commit'. Owner decision: v1 unit tests stay until v2 passes the kept ones. 136 of 210 v1 tests import ../src/. Do I keep v1 src module paths and exports in v2 so those tests can run, and does CI run both vitest and node:test?
questions.why: This decides the v2 src layout on day one. If I pick wrong, the kept unit tests cannot run against v2.

questions.question: How many tools do I register: 7 or 9? TECH-SPEC:107 says src/prompt/tools/<tool>.md x7 and GP1 asserts '7 tools'. PRD-v2.md:132 says ctx_doctor and ctx_upgrade are removed as tools. TECH-SPEC Q3b and ADR-0010 say they stay as tools. Do the 8,000-char budget and lint cover 9 descriptions?
questions.why: GP1 golden and the prompt budget both depend on the count.

questions.question: What is the minimum Node version (spike S-NODE)? ADR-0002:37 says it 'was not checked'. PRD §13 says Node 22, 24. Is the spike M0 work, and if node:sqlite with timeout needs a flag on 22, do I drop 22?
questions.why: The engine choice and CI matrix depend on it. No fallback engine is allowed.

questions.question: Windows kill: PRD-v2.md:138 says 'Windows Job Object'. v1 uses taskkill /F /T (src/executor.ts:196-206, from 8a778ba9 2026-03-01 'fix: Windows process tree kill (taskkill /F /T) + fix recursive killTree'). Node has no Job Object API and v2 bans native addons. Do I keep taskkill, and is it inside the 40 ms hook budget path or only in the server?
questions.why: r2 flagged this; PRD is unchanged. Choosing Job Object needs a native addon, which the no-native rule bans.
